standard.summary: Newbie 模型的 LoRA 注入范围预设。minimal 只注入最关键的层；balanced 注入 attention + 部分 FFN；full 注入所有层。
standard.effect: minimal 参数最少训练最快；balanced 是推荐默认值；full 参数最多但质量天花板最高。
standard.whenToUse: balanced 适合大多数场景。minimal 用于快速原型验证。full 在大数据集上追求最高质量时使用。
standard.avoidWhen: full 在数据量少时容易过拟合。

standard_en.summary: The LoRA injection-scope preset for a Newbie model. minimal injects only the most critical layers; balanced injects attention plus some of the FFN; full injects every layer.
standard_en.effect: minimal has the fewest parameters and trains fastest; balanced is the recommended default; full has the most parameters and the highest quality ceiling.
standard_en.whenToUse: balanced suits most cases. minimal is for quick prototype validation. full is for chasing the highest quality on a large dataset.
standard_en.avoidWhen: full overfits easily when there is little data.

advanced.principle: Newbie 使用 Gemma3 作为文本编码器。newbie_gemma3_prompt 可以指定额外的系统 prompt。newbie_use_flash_attn2 启用 Flash Attention 2 加速。newbie_block_residency 控制 DiT block 的 GPU 驻留策略。newbie_adapter_type 可以切换 lora/lora_fa/vera/lokr。
advanced.intervention: trainer.py 根据 newbie_lora_target 预设决定注入哪些 Transformer 层。
advanced.expectedImpact: balanced 在参数效率和表达能力之间取得最佳平衡。
advanced.tradeoffs: newbie_target_modules 允许手动指定目标模块列表（覆盖预设）。newbie_force_cache_only 强制使用缓存路径。
advanced.codePath: trainer.py:Newbie route → lora_target preset → layer injection

advanced_en.principle: Newbie uses Gemma3 as its text encoder. newbie_gemma3_prompt can specify an extra system prompt. newbie_use_flash_attn2 enables Flash Attention 2 acceleration. newbie_block_residency controls the DiT blocks' GPU residency policy. newbie_adapter_type can switch lora/lora_fa/vera/lokr.
advanced_en.intervention: trainer.py decides which Transformer layers to inject per the newbie_lora_target preset.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: balanced strikes the best balance between parameter efficiency and expressiveness.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: newbie_target_modules allows manually specifying the target module list (overriding the preset). newbie_force_cache_only forces the cached path.
advanced_en.codePath: trainer.py:Newbie route → lora_target preset → layer injection
